overview:
The **Battle of Telos IV** (3958 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Mandalorian Wars**, fought on or above **Telos IV**. A decisive engagement of the mandalorian wars.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Mandalorian Wars in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Telos IV within the broader **Mandalorian Wars** campaign. Front-line reports describe a decisive engagement of the mandalorian wars.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3958 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Mandalorian Wars.
significance: The Battle of Telos IV illustrates how the Mandalorian Wars reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
